samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers. The module generates a divided clock output by an odd divisor value provided as a parameter.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV">Odd divisor value used for frequency division. Default value is 5.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt1">Counter for tracking rising edge of input clock.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt2">Counter for tracking falling edge of input clock.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div1">Positive edge clock divider.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div2">Negative edge clock divider.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Defines the frequency divider logic based on the input parameters and clock signal. Uses two separate counters to track rising and falling edges of input clock, and toggles corresponding clock dividers when counters reach half of NUM_DIV. Output divided clock is the logical OR of positive and negative edge clock dividers.</implementation>
</module>
